name: Docker Hub API
tagline: Registry and Hub metadata API for images, tags, repos, and orgs
description: Docker Hub’s HTTP API for registry content and Hub account data: list repositories, tags, and manifests; manage orgs and access; and integrate pulls/pushes with the Docker ecosystem. Public endpoints support anonymous reads with strict rate limits; authenticated requests use personal access tokens or JWT login.

auth.details: Personal Access Token (PAT) via Bearer Authorization header, or JWT from POST /v2/users/login; anonymous read allowed with lower limits

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Docker Hub plan includes limited pull rate and API usage; exact free API quota varies by plan—confirm on pricing
pricing.paid_plans: Pro, Team, and Business plans with higher pull rates and features

rate_limits: Anonymous pulls ~100/6h per IP; authenticated higher by plan; Hub API rate limits documented per endpoint
use_cases: list tags for a Docker Hub repository
check if an image tag exists before deploy
list repositories in a Docker Hub namespace
fetch repository metadata and star/pull counts
authenticate and inspect private Hub repos with a PAT
